articles.title: Commission adopts EU Guidelines on exclusionary abuses of dominance
articles.summary_raw: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Sep 2026 The European Commission has today adopted Guidelines on the application of Article 102 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union ('TFEU') to abusive exclusionary conduct by dominant companies. The adoption of the guidelines marks the end of a three-year process in which the Commission consulted extensively with stakeholders.
